mapper.select: SELECT * FROM career_fact WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT * FROM career_fact WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND fact_type=#{factType} AND fact_key=#{factKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO career_fact(profile_id,fact_type,fact_key,value_type,boolean_value,number_value,text_value,unit,display_name,source,confirmed_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{profileId},#{factType},#{factKey},#{valueType},#{booleanValue},#{numberValue},#{textValue},#{unit},#{displayName},#{source},#{confirmedAt},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value_type=VALUES(value_type),boolean_value=VALUES(boolean_value),number_value=VALUES(number_value),text_value=VALUES(text_value),unit=VALUES(unit),display_name=VALUES(display_name),source=VALUES(source),confirmed_at=VALUES(confirmed_at),updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM career_fact WHERE id=#{id} AND profile_id=#{profileId}
